program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-1@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-1@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-1@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-1@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-1. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-1@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-2@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-2@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-2@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-2. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-2@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

messaging.detail: Texting setup is not available yet. Preferences do not purchase or register service.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-3&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-3. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-3&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-3. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-3@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Newer canonical shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Newer canonical shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-3&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-3. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Newer canonical shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Newer canonical shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Newer canonical shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Newer canonical shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Newer canonical shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Newer canonical shop: help with service texts at website-order-3@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-4&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-4. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-4@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-4&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-4. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-4@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-4&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-4. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-4@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-5&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-5. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-5@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-5&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-5. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-5@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-5&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-5. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-5@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-6&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-6. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-6@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person
Give advice on gas, electrical, or safety beyond: leave the area if there is a gas smell or fire, call 911, then call us
handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
emergencies.tier2: Everything else: offer the next available window.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-6&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-6. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-6@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

program.description: Current Website Shop sends one-to-one customer care replies to people who initiate a text conversation about requested home services. Separately agreed ongoing appointment texts cover saved-visit confirmations, reminders and cancellations, including future visits with this business. An inbound conversation alone does not authorize recurring appointment updates. This program does not send on-the-way alerts, promotions, purchased-list outreach, review requests or unrelated marketing.
program.messageFlow: Customers first text Current Website Shop at its published service number about a home-service request. Website and phone bookings may invite the customer to text APPOINTMENTS or CITAS from the mobile saved for the visit; the invitation sends nothing. The inbound SMS permits direct replies in that conversation only. When a visit is saved by text, or the recipient texts APPOINTMENTS or CITAS, the front desk names the business and asks by SMS whether the recipient wants ongoing appointment confirmations, reminders and cancellation texts from this business, including future visits. The question discloses variable frequency, message and data rates, HELP and STOP, and that booking is available without texts. A separate written YES after that question is required. The question, inbound reply, recipient number, provider message IDs, time and wording version ongoing_appointments_v2 are recorded. Older consent for one visit is not widened to future visits. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts; HELP or AYUDA for assistance. START or EMPEZAR removes a previous texting block but does not grant recurring appointment consent. Terms: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-6&page=terms. Privacy: https://website-concurrency.fixture.invalid/policy?c=website-order-6. No texting consent is inferred from signup, a phone call, website chat, a missed call or merely providing a number.
messageSamples: Current Website Shop: your requested service visit is saved for tomorrow, 8 to 12. The shop confirms arrival details directly. Reply STOP to end texts or HELP for help.
Current Website Shop: a reminder about your service appointment tomorrow, 12 to 5. Reply if you need to change it. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to end texts.
Current Website Shop: your service visit has been cancelled. Reply here with a question, HELP for assistance, or STOP to end texts.
program.optInMessage: Current Website Shop: your texting block is removed. Appointment updates need a separate YES after our appointment-text question. HELP for help, STOP/ALTO/PARAR to end. Message and data rates may apply.
program.optOutMessage: Current Website Shop: you will receive no more service texts. START or EMPEZAR restores a previous opt-out.
program.helpMessage: Current Website Shop: help with service texts at website-order-6@example.test. Reply STOP, ALTO or PARAR to end texts. Message and data rates may apply.

result.dataPolicy: Your customers' names, numbers, and conversations belong to your shop. Machines & Cloud uses them only to run your front desk, never to train or inform another shop's desk, and never sells or shares them. You can ask for an export at any time, and everything we hold is deleted on request after you cancel. Our phone and texting providers keep their own call and message logs for a limited time under their policies, and a customer's request to stop texts is kept so it is honored.

never: Quote a price the owner has not published
Promise an exact arrival time; offer the arrival windows only
Pretend to be a person

handoff: Anything about a bill or refund

tier0: Sparks or a burning smell from the panel or an outlet
tier1: No cooling when the forecast high is 90°F or more
No cooling with an infant, elderly, or medically dependent person in the home
No heat when it is at or below freezing outside
Water pouring from the air handler
